mintAuthority.summary: steakUSDC is an immutable MetaMorpho ERC-4626 vault (no proxy). Shares mint only through deposits. Vault owner is VaultV2Supervisor (0x4d7bd498bb24098ca281c05519629c605407f71d), itself owned by the observed Steakhouse 5-of-10 Safe; base USDC issuance remains inherited from Circle.

controls.label: steakUSDC MetaMorpho vault (immutable, deposit-only mint)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295178: EIP-1967 proxy_admin slot = 0x0 and impl slot = 0x0 (immutable, not upgradeable). owner() = 0x4d7bd498bb24098ca281c05519629c605407f71d (VaultV2Supervisor, Blockscout confirmed). Fixed-block reads at Ethereum block 25573280 reconfirmed asset() = USDC, owner() = VaultV2Supervisor, and VaultV2Supervisor.owner() = the Steakhouse Safe. The vault has no privileged share-mint method outside the ERC-4626 deposit flow.

controls.label: Steakhouse vault owner chain — 5-of-10 Safe (parameter control)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25573280, vault owner() = VaultV2Supervisor and VaultV2Supervisor.owner() = this Safe. getOwners() returned the listed 10 EOAs, getThreshold() returned 5, and getModulesPaginated() returned an empty list. The reviewed Safe service state reports a zero guard. The Safe controls curator, allocator, and fee parameters only; it cannot mint shares outside deposits.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25573280, the vault remained direct code with zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots. asset() = USDC, and the owner chain resolves to the listed 5-of-10 Safe; its modules list is empty, while guard enumeration remains unavailable through this Safe ABI. The vault is an immutable deposit-only wrapper, so wrapper reconciliation is not a separate issuer reserve regime and durable USDC issuance remains inherited from Circle.
